name: ReportCrime
description: Add a bounty for a crime a witness in this conversation saw the player commit.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - World and Advanced Actions on in Mantella. Guards only. A guard adds a bounty only when another NPC is present as a witness. Keep Mantella's own AbsolveCrime and ReportCrime off.
prompt: If you are a guard, steward or Jarl and someone here tells you they saw the player commit a crime, begin your response with '{key}:'
